args.lesson: What worked: the Shopify App Store listing gave readable USD pricing for Matrixify after its official page returned 403. LitExtension's static HTML exposed its pricing and FAQ terms. 4 of 6 FETCHes used. What failed: Cart2Cart renders prices client-side, so the static fetch had no prices, and the matrixify.app 403 was not bypassed. Finding: no comparable human catalogue-QA price exists. LitExtension gives an unlimited free 20-product demo and is free under 100 products; Matrixify costs USD20/month. So input-only validation of 20 rows competes with free tools. The differentiated job is verifying client-produced rows against the source. Verdict: CHANGE the scope emphasis and keep CAD60 as the per-order floor, because fixed operator admin dominates. At the assumed 2-5.25 h, CAD60 works out to CAD11-30 per total hour (hours are assumptions). Next time: get the app-store listing first when a vendor site blocks fetches. Do not edit the public page without an inbound request.
